canonical_topology_audit.node_labels_ignored: document labels only; q and relation types are fixed
canonical_topology_audit.t1_t2_implication: T1 and T2 share the same typed unlabeled collider topology, so holding one out does not test an unseen topology family
canonical_topology_audit.t3_implication: The degree-preserving 2-switch keeps the same typed unlabeled two-branch topology; its counterfactual signal depends on fixed document identities or attributes rather than an unlabeled graph motif

definitions.operation_deduplication: directed endpoint pairs are sets; one gold-edge/other-edge pair is counted once regardless of the number of mentioning sentences
definitions.t1: exactly one real directed mention edge exists between the two gold documents; both endpoints have real top-k retrieval edges; the counterfactual reverses the mention direction
definitions.t2: for asymmetric real gold edge u->v, positive edges are q->u and u->v; the counterfactual keeps u->v and moves the real top-k retrieval anchor to q->v
definitions.t3_natural: the same four-document target-swap, but both switched mention edges already exist in the unmodified graph
definitions.t3_synthetic: combine asymmetric gold edge u->v with a real mention edge a->b over four distinct documents; q->u and q->a must both be real top-k retrieval anchors; target-swap to u->b and a->v, both of which must be absent

reasons: T1 and T2 have overlapping canonical typed negative topology
T3 is incompatible with the current two-document single-path unit
four-document T3 and current two-document T1/T2 require different verifier input schemas

single_path_t3.definition: a q->d_i->d_j scoring unit has only two document nodes and one mention edge, while a degree-preserving 2-switch requires two edges over four distinct document nodes
